name: What should I look for when selecting a contractor for rental property interior repairs?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when selecting a contractor for rental property interior repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, prioritize experience with rental properties and local regulations, valid licenses, and comprehensive insurance (liability and workers' compensation). Request and check references from previous clients, and review their portfolio. Obtain detailed, written estimates that outline the scope of work, materials, timeline, and payment schedule. A good contractor should also communicate clearly and offer solutions that fit your budget and property's needs. Don't hesitate to ask about their approach to project management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed and insured contractors with experience in rental properties, check references, review portfolios, and get detailed written estimates. Prioritize clear communication and project management.
